title: OP Script God Mode and more
script:
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Heal"):FireServer()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local GodMode = false
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theneutral0ne/wally-modified/refs/heads/main/wally-modified.lua")))()
local Window = Library:CreateWindow('Credit: Neutral')
Window:Toggle("God Mode", {}, function(value)
    GodMode = value
    if GodMode then
        for i = 1,1000 do
            ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Choice:FireServer("Tower")
        end
    end
end)
Window:Button("Inf HP (Must be Lvl 2+)", function()
    for i = 1,1000 do
        ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Choice:FireServer("Tower")
    end
end)
Window:Button("Inf Damage (Must be Lvl 2+)", function()
    for i = 1,100 do
        ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Choice:FireServer("Giant")
    end
end)
Window:Button("Inf Attack Speed (Must be Lvl 2+)", function()
    for i = 1,100 do
        ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Choice:FireServer("Trident")
    end
end)
Window:Button("Inf Luck (Must be Lvl 2+)", function()
    for i = 1,100 do
        ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Choice:FireServer("Spades")
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if GodMode then
        ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Heal:FireServer()
    end
end)
